name: Bear Scouts
summary:
In this free multiplayer social game, you play as a bear scout hanging out at camp with your friends! 🐻

**Take care of the camp** 🔥

Gather wood around the forest to keep the campfire burning and enjoy grilled marshmallows under the stars, then help keep the camp clean by picking up any trash you find along the way!
